meta.label: BTCUSDT spot, 1-minute bars from Binance, 2023-01 to 2024-12
meta.note: The DDQN's best epoch was chosen on this validation split, so its figure here is optimistic; the untouched test split is the unbiased check.

cost_description:
Cost model - each cost is a fraction of the fill price, charged per child order.
sigma = rolling std of step log-returns; V = rolling mean step volume (both use past bars only).
  [ON ] fees         : 1 bps of notional
  [ON ] spread       : fixed half-spread = 0.5 bps
  [ON ] temp impact  : eta * sigma * (q/V)^delta, eta=1, delta=0.5  (eta is an assumption, not calibrated)
  [OFF] perm impact  : later prices shift by gamma * (qty already bought / prev-day volume), gamma=0.05  (counterfactual: history never saw these trades)
  [ON ] particip. cap: q <= 10% of V; waived on the final step (forced completion, reported as forced_pct)
  Worked example: sigma=5 bps, q/V=5% -> fees 1.00 + spread 0.50 + temp impact 1.12 = 2.62 bps per unit bought
